entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: An oathbound group of planeswalkers formed on Zendikar to protect the Multiverse from threats no one else can handle.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and founding member of the Gatewatch who dies saving Liliana in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and founding Gatewatch member who plans Zendikar's Last Stand and later creates the Echoverse.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fire planeswalker and founding member of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker bonded to Zendikar and founding Gatewatch member.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch with her own agenda, and is controlled by Nicol Bolas through her demon pact.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and is later revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who takes his Oath and joins the Gatewatch, warping time around Liliana.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A member of the Weatherlight's crew who declines to officially join; later taken to New Phyrexia by Ajani.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights alongside the Gatewatch and is killed by Ajani.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
aliases: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who tries to harness the Eldrazi and is driven from Zendikar by the founders.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that ravaged Zendikar and is destroyed in Zendikar's Last Stand.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that ravaged Zendikar and is destroyed in Zendikar's Last Stand.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The last Eldrazi titan, whose influence maddens Innistrad until sealed in the moon.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon and original Eldrazi jailor who berates Jace and later takes Bolas's body to the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker and original Eldrazi jailor.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An original Eldrazi jailor, later infected on New Phyrexia while defending Kaito.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who manipulated the Eldrazi's release and builds an army of Eternals.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps Jace on Innistrad and seals Emrakul with the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker serving Bolas who runs a plot at the Inventor's Fair on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A Renegade leader that Tezzeret was about to execute.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A vedalken emissary of the Consulate of Kaladesh who tries to hire the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon who rules the Cabal on Dominaria and is killed by the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God-Eternal killed by Gideon with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A God-Eternal who shoots down Gideon's pegasus.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A demon lord who catches Gideon and brings him within striking distance of Bolas.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A rival planeswalker suspected of petrifying Azorius Senate members and later captured on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Jace's assistant on Ravnica who maintains the Gatewatch's headquarters there.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker who is compleated on New Phyrexia and hunts Nissa.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who takes a detonating Sylex off New Phyrexia and returns as an archangel.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the planning against New Phyrexia and helps open paths for angels.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Leader of the Mirran camp on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch formed during the Eldrazi devastation.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city on Zendikar, left in ruins by the Eldrazi, which gave the Gatewatch its name.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The Zendikar location whose cliffs overlook Sea Gate, where the oaths are sworn.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's homeplane, where Emrakul's influence caused madness.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane of the Gatewatch's headquarters and the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of the Inventor's Fair and the Renegades' rebellion.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas creates his army of Eternals.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The gathering point after Amonkhet.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Jace is trapped by the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane the Gatewatch assault in the Brother's War era.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that traps planeswalkers on a plane.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A sword Gideon uses to kill Rhonas, which breaks against Bolas.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Liliana's artifact radiating dark magic, containing Onakke spirits.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A device planned to destroy Realmbreaker; Elspeth takes it detonating off the plane.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A Phyrexian device the strike teams try to destroy or refuse.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient world-devouring beings released on Zendikar.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Zombified fighting specialists of Bolas's army.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A Dominarian organization ruled by Belzenlok.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The airship the Gatewatch members boarded to fight the Cabal.

entities.name: Formation of the Gatewatch
entities.description: The 4559 AR event on Zendikar that expelled Ob Nixilis and founded the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Zendikar's Last Stand
entities.description: The plan that destroyed Kozilek and Ulamog by drawing their being into Zendikar.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The final confrontation with Bolas on Ravnica.

entities.name: The Desparkening
entities.description: The event that cost many Gatewatch members their spark and opened omenpaths.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: Jace's creation, an alternative multiverse free of suffering.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis traps Gideon, Jace, and Nissa while seeking the Eldrazi's power; Chandra frees them and they drive him from Zendikar.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar arrived in time to free her fellow planeswalkers, and together they forced Ob Nixilis to flee Zendikar.

events.summary: On the cliffs of Tazeem the four pledge their oaths, founding the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Gideon, Jace, Chandra, and Nissa pledged their oaths to protect not only Zendikar but the entire Multiverse from threats too great to face alone

events.summary: Jace and Nissa devise a plan to destroy the titans permanently, breaking Jace's promise to Ugin.
events.quote: Jace and Nissa devised a plan to destroy Kozilek and Ulamog permanently

events.summary: With Chandra's massive fire spell the Gatewatch kills the Eldrazi titans in Zendikar's Last Stand.
events.quote: Helped by a massive fire spell of Chandra, they succeeded.

events.summary: Ugin berates Jace and his friends for killing the ancient creatures.
events.quote: Jace and his friends were berated by Ugin for killing the ancient creatures

events.summary: On Innistrad, Emrakul's influence causes madness; Jace brings the Gatewatch back, Liliana arrives with a zombie army, and Nissa is nearly killed by the Chain Veil's power.
events.quote: On Innistrad, Jace found only madness that affected the entire plane

events.summary: Emrakul is sealed in Innistrad's moon, and Liliana decides to join the Gatewatch to direct it.
events.quote: Emrakul had been sealed in Innistrad's moon by the Gatewatch and Tamiyo

events.summary: Liliana makes clear that the Gatewatch fights planeswalker threats, not local unrest, when Dovin Baan asks them to guard the Inventor's Fair.
events.quote: Liliana, however, quickly made clear that the Gatewatch intended to combat other planeswalkers and similar extraplanar threats, not local unrest.

events.summary: The Gatewatch confronts Tezzeret at the arena; he ends the Inventor's Fair and retreats, having used them as a distraction.
events.quote: Tezzeret announced the end of the Inventor's Fair and retreated to a skyship

events.summary: Ajani joins the Gatewatch after they aid the Renegades' rebellion.
events.quote: They were helped by Ajani Goldmane , who afterward joined the team.

events.summary: On Amonkhet the Gatewatch confronts Bolas and is soundly defeated, scattering; Jace is trapped on Ixalan.
events.quote: When they confronted the dragon, they were soundly defeated.

events.summary: Jace becomes trapped on Ixalan by the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Jace became trapped on Ixalan by the power of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Nissa leaves the Gatewatch after losing Jace and angered by Liliana.
events.quote: The shock of losing Jace, as well as the anger towards Liliana's actions, caused Nissa to leave the Gatewatch.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold and kills Belzenlok.
events.quote: managed to defeat the Cabal's Stronghold and kill Belzenlok

events.summary: Teferi makes his Oath and joins the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Then Teferi made his Oath and joined the Gatewatch.

events.summary: Liliana falls under Bolas's control through her demon pact.
events.quote: Liliana, who fell under the control of Nicol Bolas due to her pact with the demons that he had brokered

events.summary: The Gatewatch arrives on Ravnica and is trapped by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: they immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
events.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with the Blackblade and draining his essence

events.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon's flesh.
events.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

events.summary: Bolas saves Liliana from the assassination attempt by destroying the buildings under Jace's team.
events.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

events.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself, taking the demons' contract on himself to save Liliana.
events.quote: Gideon sacrificed himself to save her, using his hieromancy to take the contract and its lethal effects upon himself

events.summary: After Bolas's defeat, Jace hides with an illusion that Ugin took Bolas's body away.
events.quote: At Ugin's request, Jace used an illusion to hide the fact that Ugin had planeswalked away with Bolas' body

events.summary: Kaya joins and Nissa rejoins the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Kaya joined and Nissa rejoined the Gatewatch

events.summary: Ajani is revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent and kills Jaya Ballard, then takes Karn to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Ajani was revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent and killed Jaya Ballard during the second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: Elspeth takes a detonating Sylex off New Phyrexia, ending the covert mission in failure.
events.quote: Elspeth took a detonating Sylex off the plane, marking the end of the Gatewatch's mission as a failure

events.summary: Lukka is compleated and hunts down Nissa.
events.quote: he was quickly compleated and hunted down Nissa

events.summary: Chandra and Wrenn refuse Realmbreaker with Elspeth's return as an archangel; Norn's demise neutralizes the Phyrexians, but the Desparkening costs many their spark.
events.quote: Chandra and Wrenn went to New Phyrexia in a second attempt to refuse Realmbreaker, which was successful with Elspeth's return as an archangel

events.summary: Jace, after undoing his compleation, decides to create an alternative to the Multiverse; the Gatewatch regroups to fight him.
events.quote: After undoing his compleation on Vryn , he decided to fix the Multiverse by creating an alternative to it , free of suffering.

relations.quote: The founding members were Gideon Jura , Jace Beleren , Chandra Nalaar , and Nissa Revane .
